entities.summary: The Haepyeong Gil clan is a Korean clan. Their bon-gwan is in Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province. According to research conducted in 2015, there were 35,823 members of the Haepyeong Gil clan. Their founder was Gil Dang, one of the 'Eight Scholars' that emigrated to Goryeo from Song China.
